color.description: The colour of the product itself, however the supplier spelled or abbreviated it.

terms.Black: Colour black, including jet black, ink, coal and other near-black shades.
terms.White: Colour white, including off-white, ivory and cream.
terms.Navy: Dark blue verging on black. Distinct from the brighter Blue.
terms.Blue: Mid or bright blue. Not navy, which has its own term.
terms.Grey: Any grey from light to charcoal, including silver-grey fabric.
terms.Green: Any green from olive through emerald.
terms.Beige: Sand, tan, taupe, stone and similar neutral light browns.

size.description: A garment or product size expressed on a small-to-large scale, not as a measurement.

terms.Small: The small size in an S/M/L scale, however abbreviated.
terms.Medium: The medium size in an S/M/L scale, however abbreviated.
terms.Large: The large size in an S/M/L scale, however abbreviated.
terms.Extra Large: One step above Large, however abbreviated.
terms.One Size: A single size intended to fit everyone; no size choice exists.

material.description: What the product is physically made of.

terms.Cotton: Cotton fibre, including organic and blends described as cotton.
terms.Polyester: Polyester and other synthetic plastic fibres.
terms.Leather: Animal leather, including full-grain and genuine leather.
terms.Stainless Steel: Stainless steel, including food-grade and brushed finishes.
terms.Glass: Glass, including borosilicate and tempered glass.

volume.description: The capacity of the product: how much liquid or contents it holds, written as a number and a unit.

weight.description: How heavy the product or its contents are. A mass, written as a number and a unit.
